concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-online-banking-poland-api-only]] — 2026-09-15-captured API-only guide for PL/PLN bank discovery and consent, shopperEmail/issuer field distinction, redirect/details return and pending-versus-webhook finality; source flags incomplete examples.
warnings: shopperEmail is required and at most 50 characters; paymentMethod.issuer has no required mark despite example issuer.
The item-information prose does not map to a method-specific item field in the table or samples.
Pending/Received are not final; both curl examples lack a line continuation before -d, and several SDK discovery snippets lack request construction.
